cookies.desc: Only for videos that require signing in (private, members-only or 18+).

cookies.warning_2: Sites may limit or block accounts used with downloaders. We recommend a secondary account.
cookies.warning_3: On YouTube they're only used when you ask, because they lower the available quality. The file never leaves your PC.
cookies.risk_inline: Using your account with a downloader may cause problems for it (limits or blocks). Only use it if you need to.

help.windows_title: Windows says the app isn't safe
help.windows_1: K-Downloader is free software and doesn't have its own digital signature yet. So when you download the installer, your browser or SmartScreen may show a warning. If you got it from the official website, choose “More info” and then “Run anyway”. If Windows won't open it, right-click the file › Properties › check “Unblock”.
help.windows_2: With Smart App Control on, Windows blocks new unsigned programs. That's why K-Downloader runs on the official (signed) Python and downloads FFmpeg and Deno from their official sources.
help.windows_3: If Windows blocks a component, go to Settings › Components and press Repair.
help.web_text: The website has a complete guide with every error and its fix.
